notes: 60k particles sampled across a real human head scan (the canonical Lee Perry Smith model used in three.js examples). Pairs with n8q's Lucy as 'figure ↔ portrait'. Porcelain → graphite → silver-edge palette. 2.4s reveal: particles spiral in from a horizontal ring into the rest-pose face. Slow auto-orbit + drag-to-orbit + scroll-zoom for closer inspection.
